title: High Probability Derivative Bounds for Random tanh Neural Networks on a Hypercube
abstract: arXiv:2608.26526v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We establish high-probability bounds for mixed input derivatives of wide random neural networks whose activation derivatives satisfy a factorial growth bound. Our main result specializes these estimates to $\tanh$ networks with Xavier initialization. A direct deterministic analysis based on Euclidean operator norms of the weight matrices yields derivative bounds that generally grow exponentially with the depth. We show that this growth can be substantially improved for sufficiently wide Gaussian networks by isolating the term that is linear in the highest-order derivative and controlling the corresponding tangent directions by measurable finite nets. tldr: 本文通过隔离高阶导数线性项并控制切线方向，显著改进了宽高斯tanh网络导数界随深度指数增长的局限，证明了在足够宽条件下高概率导数界可大幅改善。
en_tdlr: This paper significantly improves the exponential-with-depth growth of derivative bounds for wide Gaussian tanh networks by isolating the linear term in the highest-order derivative and controlling tangent directions, proving that high-probability bounds can be substantially enhanced under sufficient width conditions.
